answer: Run identity issuance like a wharf with few berths: each epoch sells only 50 new key slots by sealed-bid auction, and the reserve price climbs 10% whenever every berth fills. Bids stay a cipher until the beacon opens them, so a farm cannot mirror honest bids to undercut them. Landing 100 sybils takes two full epochs at escalating prices, roughly 400 POA in burned bids against about 150 POA of capped rewards: a net loss.
